trace.notes: failure_mode=metadata_only and paywalled_or_restricted. The DOI resolved to the ScienceDirect article preview for PII S0045782505005037, which confirmed the article title, journal, pages, DOI, abstract, and section-snippet headings, but exposed access-through-organization and purchase-PDF controls rather than a readable full-text article or PDF artifact. The visible 'Conclusions and open problems' section snippet is truncated and is not a full problem-statement source.

Bounded exact-work recovery used the DOI, the exact title, the exact title plus PDF, the PII S0045782505005037, and the authors Strouboulis, Babuška, and Hidajat. Candidate pages were rejected because ResearchGate explicitly reported no full text available, ScienceDirect pages were preview/metadata only, the TAMU dissertation was a different work, and Part II/DML/other search hits were related or citing works rather than the same exact source.
No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the open-problem statements was recovered.

Candidate extraction was skipped because the source-adequacy gate forbids extracting accepted questions from abstracts, citation metadata, article previews, section snippets, or search snippets when the full technical problem statements are not visible in a readable primary source artifact.
No items were accepted because accepted questions require verbatim evidence with page numbers or stable locators from a readable primary source artifact.
Saved the exact JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/5194413.json and outputs/latest.json.
